correctness.rationale: Direct multiplication yields trace T(x)=T0-(a+b)^2x and determinant U(x)=U0-4a^2b^2x. Symbolic independent expansion verified both and f_x(K0) with K0=4a^2b^2/(a+b)^2; the latter is negative for unequal a,b and 0<=m<=1/2, placing K0 strictly between the two real eigenvalues. Implicit differentiation then gives strictly negative derivative of the larger root. In source-sink case U<1 ensures the smaller root below 1, so sign f_x(1) decides invasion. Exact rational example a=7/5,b=1/10,m=1/4 gives endpoint 197/200<1 and threshold 4829/86864.
